# 📋 Coordinate camp shift

- **Checklist types:** Morning Dominatrix, Evening Dominatrix
- **Area:** Common area
- **When:** Before and after every scheduled Morning, Afternoon, Pre-event, Bar, Liaison, Cheese, and Post-event shift

## What you need

- 📦 Shift Assignment Sheet — At the Dominatrix station. On-playa assignment sheet showing who is scheduled for each shift. Personal assignments are not stored in this repository.
- 📦 Generated Checklists — At the Dominatrix station and each applicable work station. Printed assignment and status checklists generated from canonical task checklist types. Each row links to the task instructions and shows when the task applies; row order is not an execution sequence.
- 📦 Camp Issue Log — At the Dominatrix station. On-playa log for unresolved task, supply, safety, and service issues. Do not record private incident or health details.

## Steps

1. Identify the checklist types starting next.
2. Confirm that each assigned worker is present.
   - **IF/THEN:** IF an assigned worker is absent, THEN find a willing replacement and update 📦 Shift Assignment Sheet. IF no replacement is available, THEN record the coverage gap in 📦 Camp Issue Log and tell the Camp Lead.
3. Give each worker the applicable generated checklist and task cards.
4. Brief the workers on unresolved issues that affect their tasks.
5. Review every checklist line after the shift.
6. Record every BLOCKED, ESCALATED, or incomplete line in 📦 Camp Issue Log.

## PASS when

- Every shift has workers or a recorded coverage gap.
- Every worker received the applicable checklist and task cards.
- Every completed checklist line has status, initials, and completion time.
- Every unresolved result is in the issue log.

## Finish

- Before marking PASS, return each used item to its location and leave it ready for the next person.
- Collect all MOOP.
- If an item, instruction, or solution is missing or unclear, ask the Dominatrix.

### Leave items ready

- **📦 Shift Assignment Sheet:** Every current shift has an assigned worker or a recorded coverage gap.
- **📦 Generated Checklists:** The current generated revision is present. Each completed line shows status, initials, and completion time; unresolved results are copied to 📦 Camp Issue Log.
- **📦 Camp Issue Log:** Every unresolved operational issue has a current status and next action.

## Who to ask

Camp Lead
